notes: plans/qwen38-27b-kv-cache-quantization.md WP-2 -- KV-cache-quantization candidate ladder for Qwen3.8-27B-UD-IQ3_S. This experiment covers the ladder's final tested candidate, informally labeled 'E-alt': symmetric q4_0/q4_0 KV (both K and V quantized to q4_0), -c 120000, -fa on. This deviates from the plan's literal candidate-E text ('a mixed q4/q8 combination') -- see the WP-2 report for the full rationale (D's measured cache footprint at c=40960 was LARGER than B's, proving q4-K/f16-V cannot fix the fit problem that escalated past B; the natural 'what D's own results show is actually needed' fix is to also quantize V, and a genuinely mismatched q4/q8 pair was expected per the plan's own audit disposition to hit the Ling-precedent non-fused-attention fallback penalty regardless of correctness -- so the symmetric, still-fused q4_0/q4_0 alternative was tested instead, and confirmed via scratch-log evidence to engage the fused flash-attention path with zero fallback on every one of 4 loads this WP).

Candidates B (q8_0/q8_0) and D (q4_0 K/f16 V) were tested/rejected earlier in this WP without reaching step 7 (per plan text, a full 4-file record is reserved for step-7+ candidates) -- their data is recorded in the WP-2 report and docs/qwen38-27b-bakeoff-results.md instead of here.

Quality-corpus subset (8/12 prompts, all 8 categories) run twice: once by the dispatched fork worker at max_tokens=768 (synthesis-1 hit finish_reason=length with empty content -- matching the f16 baseline's own identical truncation on the same prompt at the same budget, a known harness-default-budget artifact, not a regression), and once by the orchestrator directly at max_tokens=2048 (all 8 finish_reason=stop, samples recorded here) to get a decisive, budget-adequate read per the plan's correctness-taxonomy requirement.
